whats.OpenAI introduces local AI processing fo: Local processing of OpenAI tools in India could matter if your company cares about where its data is handled.
whats.BMAsia Music launches AI-powered Beat Br: AI is reaching everyday business tools like in-store music, so managers may soon see it in products they already buy.
whats.Nebuly Raises $21M Series A to Expand En: Investors are backing tools that measure enterprise AI, a sign that tracking results is becoming part of the job.
whats.Before India writes its AI law, it must: The headline asks who answers when AI goes wrong. Managers should decide who owns the outcome of AI decisions in their team.
whats.AI Investment Faces Returns Test Over Ne: Goldman Sachs says AI spending faces a returns test, so expect more questions about what your AI projects actually deliver.

term.def: Inference is the step where a trained AI model reads your question and produces an answer. Doing it locally means that work happens on servers in your own country.

prompt.prompt: Act as a careful advisor. I manage [team] at a [type of company]. We are thinking of using an AI tool for [task]. List five questions I should ask the vendor about cost, data handling and results.

quiz.q: BW Businessworld reports a Goldman Sachs view that AI investment faces a returns test over the next 18 months.
quiz.why: That is what the headline says. For managers, it is a reminder to link AI spending to results you can measure.

quiz.q: BMI reports that OpenAI is introducing local AI processing for businesses in India.
quiz.why: That is what the headline says. Local processing means the work of answering questions happens on servers inside India.

quiz.q: A good AI tool always knows when it is wrong and will warn you.
quiz.why: AI can give wrong answers in a very confident tone. Always check important facts, numbers and names yourself.

quiz.q: AI tools understand your business automatically, so you do not need to give them any background.
quiz.why: An AI tool only knows what it learned in training and what you tell it. Good context in your prompt gives better answers.

quiz.q: AI chatbots can sometimes make up facts that sound believable.
quiz.why: This is often called hallucination. It is why a person should review AI output before it is used for anything important.
